name: Zarethia
storyline:
Zarethia begins in Forestedge, a small settlement at the edge of the Whispering Woods, where every hero starts. What looks like rats in the pantries and wolves in the clearings soon turns into something older: a sealed letter, a hermit's failing wards in Mirefen Marsh, and a door carved by no dwarf deep in Deepdelve Mine, written in the script of the long-dead Sand Kings.

In their tomb the hero learns that the Sand Kings once bound something beneath the Abyss, and that the binding is weakening. Renewing it leads across the realm: into dragonfire, past orc warcamps, haunted spires and gorgon isles, and at last towards a vision of an Empty Throne standing beyond the edge of the world, and a crown that no one who tried to sit there ever came back with.
summary: Zarethia is a free-to-play pixel-art MMORPG for Android and PC, drawn in a Game Boy style. Players choose one of four classes (Knight, Paladin, Sorcerer or Druid) and explore an open world of continents, towns, dungeons and sea routes together with other players. Gameplay includes hunting monsters and bosses, fishing, mining, cooking and crafting equipment, trading between players, guilds, PvP and weekly server-wide invasions. One account works on both Android and PC. The game is translated into English, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish and Indonesian.
